name: Datadog Bits AI
bestFor: AI incident investigation and root-cause analysis for teams already standardized on Datadog
description: Datadog's AI agent that investigates incidents, correlates telemetry, chats over observability data, and proposes fixes — sold as a credit-based add-on to an existing Datadog subscription.

freeTier.limits: Available only as an add-on to a paid Datadog subscription — no standalone free tier

paidTier.notes: Consumption-based AI Credits starting at $500 for 500 credits on an annual commitment; credits are shared across Bits investigation, chat, security, and dev agents. Average investigation cost roughly $6.50 at committed rates. Requires an underlying Datadog plan, which is priced separately.

name: PagerDuty (AIOps)
bestFor: On-call incident response with AI-driven noise reduction and event correlation
description: Incident response and on-call management with an AIOps add-on that correlates and de-duplicates alert noise into actionable incidents, plus an AI-assisted status page and automation suite.

freeTier.limits: Free plan for up to 5 responders

paidTier.notes: Professional $21/responder/month, Business $41/responder/month (annual billing). The AIOps module is a separate add-on starting around $699/month annual (or ~$799 monthly), licensed per accepted event. Digital Operations (Enterprise) is custom.

name: Harness (AIDA)
bestFor: AI-assisted CI/CD, cloud cost management, and infrastructure-as-code in one modular platform
description: A software delivery platform (CI/CD, feature flags, cloud cost management, IaC) with AIDA, its built-in AI assistant, included even on the free tier.

freeTier.limits: Free plan includes 2,000 monthly cloud credits and AIDA AI assistance

paidTier.notes: Priced per developer across modules (Essentials bundles core CI/CD/security modules; Enterprise unlocks the full module catalog). No flat public per-seat price is listed — quote-based beyond the free tier, with 15–30% discounts reported for multi-year annual commitments.
